caption:
💵 Two shapes of money: United States vs Denmark — 1980 → 2024.

Almost the same median income, two very different shapes. In the US, the poorest tenth lives on $24 a day or less and the richest tenth on $169 or more; in Denmark, $32 and $97. Same wealth, half the spread — that's redistribution, drawn as a shape 📐

📊 Data: Gapminder Income Mountains v3, from World Bank PIP (CC BY 4.0). Daily income per person in 2017 PPP dollars; modelled estimates.
